title: 高盛：AI驱动盈利增长，互联网板块即将修复？
speaker: Kenja Lao

segments.en: So with this way, I think broadly speaking, obviously AI has continued to be a very important drive of earnings growth for the aggregate Chinese equity market.
segments.zh: 所以这样看，总体而言，AI显然持续是中国权益资产整体盈利增长的重要驱动力。

segments.en: So particularly when you look at the first half numbers, China A, for example, delivered up to 20% profit growth.
segments.zh: 尤其是看上半年数据，比如内地市场，利润增速高达20%。

segments.en: And that was the highest in the past three, four years.
segments.zh: 这是过去三四年来的最高水平。

segments.en: And obviously given the interest conversation, obviously China A is very much benefiting from the AI boom, whether it's in the US or within China.
segments.zh: 显然，鉴于市场关注度，内地市场非常受益于AI热潮，无论美国还是国内。

segments.en: Now, I think the drag or the areas that have been underperforming into earnings delivery, obviously, is the internet companies.
segments.zh: 目前，盈利表现拖累或落后的领域显然是互联网公司。

segments.en: But we have an expectation that in the upcoming resource season, which will happen in about two or three weeks, we think that would likely see in pre-meaning for recovery of earnings growth for the internet sector.
segments.zh: 但我们预计，在约两三周后的 upcoming 财报季，互联网行业盈利增长有望出现复苏前兆。
